references.text: Describes how John the Baptist was to live in the wilderness and prepare the way for the Lord, which mirrors the description of John's life in the wilderness in Luke 1:80.
The prophecy about a voice in the wilderness preparing the way for the Lord, corresponding with John the Baptist's role and life in the wilderness as described in Luke 1:80.
The prophecy about one who will clear the way, which can be seen as a precursor to John the Baptist's role and his time in the wilderness, mentioned in Luke 1:80.
Paul describes how God strengthened him, which can be paralleled with how John was strengthened in the spirit in Luke 1:80.
